title: Hair growth serum FOOH billboard
text: A street billboard comes to life when a passer-by reaches in and pulls the serum bottle out of the screen
idea: A FOOH (fake out of home) ad: a real-looking street, a digital billboard and a moment that can't happen in real life. The bottle leaves the screen and lands in her hand, so the product becomes the surprise.
why: The impossible moment in the first seconds earns the stop.
A real street makes the CGI feel believable.
The bottle and label stay large and sharp the whole time.
